What are the roots of the function $f(x)$ defined by the mapping diagram shown above?
questions.worked_solution:
The roots of the function are the values of $x$ such that $f(x)=0.$ In the given mapping diagram, we see that $f(\frac{1}{3})=0.$

Therefore, the only root of the function is $x=\frac{1}{3}.$
